correctness.rationale: Reassessed the complete replacement RESULT.md. The frozen proof erroneously identified the action on W with lambda times the exterior square in odd characteristic as well: a transposition of leaves 1 and 2 fixes w_12 at lambda=1, whereas it negates u_1 wedge u_2. The repaired proof gives the correct unordered-pair permutation with weights lambda d_i d_j in odd characteristic, and the genuine exterior-square action in characteristic two. Both are invertible and preserve the brackets. Independently: the bracket modulo W makes U the unique maximal multi-dimensional abelian subspace of the abelianization for that induced pairing; the zero [h,[h,u_i]] relation kills the shear by the zero left radical. The mixed triple bracket has diagonal evaluation 2 sum_(i<j) x_i x_j w_ij, giving the exact monomial condition or no restriction as claimed. In the kernel, the w_ik term in a bracket of lifted leaves i,j kills c_kj for three distinct indices; the w_ij term equalizes the diagonal; [h+b,u_i+c a_i]=a_i-[u_i,b], and the higher brackets are unchanged. The count is q^(m+(m+1)w+1). These checks are field-algebraic, including nonprime fields. The unchanged verify_star_aut.py, inspected but not run, checks prime-field examples and kernel constraint ranks only.

value.rationale: A full structural quotient and exact order for a natural graph Lie algebra family resolve which apparent symmetries lift and how large the invisible kernel is. In particular, nonmonomial shears on the leaf space genuinely lift in characteristic two but not in odd characteristic. The class-three kernel parameterization is not supplied by the graph automorphism group or by the known class-two subgroup results.
